answer.reason: The verses tell of the crown's making and its use in the soldiers' mockery of Jesus, and of Jesus being brought out wearing it.

clauses.english: was plaited by the soldiers and put on Jesus' head to mock him as King of the Jews
clauses.quote: platted a crown of thorns, they put it upon his head

clauses.english: was worn by Jesus when Pilate brought him out saying, Behold the man
clauses.quote: Then came Jesus forth, wearing the crown of thorns
